label: ext.blocktype ext.trigger
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.trigger

properties.contextRoute: the extension's server route the kernel asks when a queued subject is due; it answers the run's goal, intention, instructions and delivery, or nothing
properties.route: the extension's server route, under /api/x/<extId>/, the kernel posts each committed change to; it answers the subjects to queue, each with its settle time

createParameters.semantics: Declares that an extension starts runs no person asked for. The kernel keeps the queue, the settle timer and the run slot; the extension decides what a change means. Honoured only while the extension is active and the instance owner has allowed its runs. Never materializes to the working tree. BO_0264
